name: recall-courier
description: Unofficial plugin that lets Claude control the Anki desktop app on your own computer through the AnkiConnect add-on: add cards, manage decks, find and edit notes, and more. Not affiliated with Anki or Ankitects.

anki_connect_url.title: AnkiConnect URL
anki_connect_url.description: Where the AnkiConnect add-on listens on this computer. Leave the default unless you changed webBindPort in AnkiConnect's settings. Only localhost addresses are accepted.

anki_connect_api_key.title: AnkiConnect API key (optional)
anki_connect_api_key.description: Only needed if you set an apiKey in Anki under Tools > Add-ons > AnkiConnect > Config. Leave empty otherwise.

auto_launch.title: Start Anki automatically
auto_launch.description: Let the plugin launch the Anki app when it is not running. Turn off if you prefer to open Anki yourself.
